comparison.objective: Use a rake to extract chips from undercut T-slots into a collection bay; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: End-entry tool insertion beneath ledges, channel traversal, and chip pulling versus recessed key engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Five chips must leave three channels and the rake return to its supports; candidate uses explicit dynamic-cycle and lock-drift criteria. Chip/bay containment and tool-pose tolerances are unstated.
comparison.reason: Undercut cleaning is distinct constrained tool use, not dynamic parameter tuning.
